minecraft_version.description: The Minecraft version this item list targets

renewable.$comment: If block is renewable (infinite), some are 'vault_only', which means they are only renewable when more than 128 players open a vault, which makes them not renewable in singleplayer

block.$comment: Block-specific properties. Required when isBlock is true.

fireResistant.$comment: If this item is fire resistant (e.g. netherite)

craftingIngredient.$comment: If this item is used in any crafting recipe

isArmorTrimMaterial.$comment: If this item is a material for armor trims

burnTimeSeconds.$comment: Time in seconds this item burns for

numberOfItemsSmelted.$comment: The number of items that can be smelted per fuel

fuel.$comment: If this item can be used as fuel in a furnace

obtainability.$comment: survival: Standard gameplay. creative_only: Requires commands or creative menu (e.g., Command Block, Barrier). unobtainable: Technical blocks with no item form (e.g., Nether Portal block, Piston Head).

craftable.$comment: Can be obtained by a crafting recipe

requiresSilkTouch.$comment: Block requires Silk Touch to drop in this form

requiresSpecialToolsToDrop.$comment: Requires a specific tool at least, if not provided, it drops by hand.

oneOf.$comment: Block item — isBlock must be true and block sub-object must be present. Item-only fields (damage, durability, possibleEnchantments) are forbidden.
Non-block item — isBlock must be false and block sub-object must not be present.
